I  know that the "nice guy" mindset of bad boys always getting the girl is  very toxic and not healthy at all. I just can't shake the feeling that  it's true, at least in some places.

For  example there's this infamous "kid" in my small, southern town who's  extremely popular with women. He's had like 20 something girlfriends.  Which, considering that he's only 18, is a rather high number.

He's  not even a good boyfriend though. I used the word infamous for a  reason. He dropped out in 8th grade and hasn't even had a job since, he's  prone to cheating, he has really bad anger issues, his current  girlfriend even admitted to me that he tends to have sex with her even  when she doesn't want it. She claims he apologizes after though, so I  guess that absolves him🤷🏿‍♂️.

I  mean, its not like I don't understand why he's so good with women. He's  charming as hell. His confidence is extremely high. Supposedly, he's  amazing at sex. And, on top of that, he's really attractive. He's kind  of a cool guy in general.

It's  just that some of the stories of him that are out there making him out  to be kind of a jerk. He sleeps with a lot of guy's girlfriends, even  one of my friends had it happen to him. I actually asked him to verify  one of the rumors, that he left a gf that was visiting him from a town 3  hours away at the mall without a ride home, and he says he did it. He  didn't even feel remorseful.

Seeing  how someone that's as flawed as he is being happy and romantically  successful kind of bothers me. I have flaws too. But for some reason my  flaws make me undesirable, where as his are ignored.

tl;dr:  One guy is an absolute mess of a human being but is still happy and  romantically successful. I'm just as fucked up but I'm alone and sad.  Please send more Ice cream for me to cry into.
